# Incident with several GitHub Services

## What Changed

Sep 13, 10:44 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Sep 13, 10:28 UTC Update - Pull Requests is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate. Sep 13, 10:26 UTC Update - We have reduced load on this cluster with internal load-shedding and are seeing signs of recovery but continue to monitor Sep 13, 09:36 UTC Update - We're seeing increased database replication delays on collab which is causing increased error rates in authorization endpoints and follow-on increased error rates across the system - we are investigating Sep 13, 09:25 UTC Update - Actions is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate. Sep 13, 09:16 UTC Investigating - We are investigating reports of degraded availability for API Requests, Issues, Pages and Pull Requests
